description: Reproducible whole-source fallback attribution. Every source_fallback original maps to exactly one category; family_residual:* means no shared cross-family debt was isolated at the D-325 census. Regenerate with fallback_attribution.py --emit, do not hand-edit. The predicate_sufficiency table records, from measured drawn/fallback co-occurrence, whether each debt is a proven sufficient blocker or only a co-occurring primary suspect.

corpus_isolation_findings.experiment: for each of the 12 fallback fixtures in this category, removed every linkStyle statement and re-rendered; separately verified on a minimal body that linkStyle alone is a sufficient blocker (with=fallback, without=drawn).
corpus_isolation_findings.conclusion: sufficient in isolation but never the sole blocker in the frozen corpus; implementing a linkStyle parser alone yields 0 additional drawn rows and requires a production parser change, so it is deferred, not actioned as an optional gain.

optional_gains.note: proven sufficient blocker (zero drawn co-occurrence); a future compact owned cohort may close it like RFC 0033 group-edge. Recorded per TechLead D-325/D-327, not actioned during registry landing. Cross-check corpus_isolation_findings for real-corpus closeability.
